# intrepidkarthi.com

> Personal website of Karthikeyan NG (Karthik) — engineer, author, speaker, and full-time trader on perpetual futures markets.

## About

Karthik is a builder-architect with 16+ years shipping software. Based between Bengaluru and Dubai. His work spans crypto infrastructure, AI/ML, trading systems, and product engineering.

Career highlights: CTO at Pi42 (crypto exchange), Director of Engineering at nference (healthcare AI on 2.5PB data), Head of Tech at Chumbak, founder of GazeMatic (420k+ downloads). Published two ML books with Packt in 2018. TEDx speaker (2017). 18+ hackathon wins.

## Current Projects

- [feaws.xyz](https://feaws.xyz): Quantitative trading lab for Bitcoin/crypto. 70% accuracy on 30 test windows. Public whitepaper + live trades. Stack: Python, Polymarket API, GDELT, sentiment analysis.
- [DailyVox](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/dailyvox-why-i-built-a-voice-journal-that-stays-on-your-phone/): Offline AI voice diary for iOS. 100% on-device, zero cloud, AES-256-GCM encryption.
- [VisionPay.com](https://visionpay.com): Stablecoin settlement infrastructure.
- [1wealth.ai](https://1wealth.ai): Crypto fintech infrastructure.

## Published Books

- [Mobile Artificial Intelligence Projects](https://intrepidkarthi.com/lab/) (Packt, 2018): TensorFlow Lite + Core ML, end-to-end mobile AI projects.
- [Machine Learning for Mobile Applications](https://intrepidkarthi.com/lab/) (Packt, 2018): Mental models and architecture decisions for mobile ML.

## High-priority writing

### Crypto / quant infrastructure

- [feaws — the quant lab is public, and so is the math](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/feaws-whitepaper-explained.md): Plain-English walkthrough of the feaws whitepaper. Five hypotheses, one engine, every trade public.
- [feaws: how I built a Bitcoin forecasting engine from scratch](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/feaws-how-i-built-a-bitcoin-forecasting-engine-from-scratch.md): GARCH + ML + Merton jump diffusion + HMM regime detection, all walked through with numbers.
- [Anatomy of a perpetual futures matching engine](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/anatomy-of-a-perpetual-futures-matching-engine.md): What actually happens between an order hitting the gateway and a fill landing on the wire.
- [Funding rates, explained without the hand-waving](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/funding-rates-explained-without-the-handwaving.md): The formula, the cadence, and how to read funding as a regime indicator.
- [Liquidation cascades — the 30 seconds after BTC drops 3%](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/liquidation-cascades-the-30-seconds-after-btc-drops-3.md): Why the cascade is structural, not panic, with the May 19 2021 walkthrough.
- [Why backtests lie — survivorship and look-ahead bias in crypto tick data](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/why-backtests-lie-survivorship-look-ahead-bias-crypto.md): The seven biases that make backtests look better than reality.
- [The case for publishing your strategy](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/the-case-for-publishing-your-strategy.md): Why transparency is the edge, not the leak. Five claims, one falsifiable test.
- [INR-margined perps — why they had to exist](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/inr-margined-perps-why-they-had-to-exist.md): The structural currency risk hidden inside USDT-margined perps for Indian traders.
- [What I learned from running a public PnL](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/what-i-learned-from-running-a-public-pnl.md): A year of publicly broadcast trading PnL — five lessons that do not show up in any trading book.

### On-device AI / iOS infrastructure (DailyVox)

- [DailyVox: why I built a voice journal that stays on your phone](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/dailyvox-why-i-built-a-voice-journal-that-stays-on-your-phone.md): The launch post. Nine Apple frameworks, zero third-party dependencies, "Data Not Collected" certification.
- [SFSpeechRecognizer deep dive](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/sfspeechrecognizer-on-device-deep-dive.md): What `requiresOnDeviceRecognition = true` actually gets you. Architecture, latency, battery, gotchas.
- [Apple Intelligence vs sending it to OpenAI — the actual tradeoffs](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/apple-intelligence-vs-openai-tradeoffs.md): Same task, two providers. Latency, cost, capability, privacy with numbers.
- [Why "Data Not Collected" is a moat in 2026](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/why-data-not-collected-is-a-moat.md): Apple's strictest privacy label. What it actually requires and why the gap will widen.
- [The TwinEngine — building a personality model entirely on-device](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/the-twinengine-personality-model-on-device.md): Architecture for a Twin that runs entirely on iPhone — extraction, aggregation, query layers.
- [CoreData + CloudKit encrypted sync without trusting Apple](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/coredata-cloudkit-encrypted-sync.md): User-held keys, AES-256-GCM, iCloud Keychain key sync, conflict resolution.
- [CryptoKit AES-256-GCM in iOS apps — what is easy, what is not](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/cryptokit-aes-256-gcm-in-ios-apps.md): Practical guide for shipping authenticated encryption correctly.
- [The economics of on-device AI — zero API cost is not the same as free](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/the-economics-of-on-device-ai.md): Engineering cost, device-tier requirements, capability ceiling, marketing premium.

### India fintech & regulation

- [The RBI vs crypto exchange timeline — 2018 to today](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/rbi-vs-crypto-exchange-timeline.md): Four years of regulatory whiplash, in dates, with the operator-side cost of each step.
- [Why FIU registration changed everything for Indian crypto](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/why-fiu-registration-changed-everything.md): The March 2023 gazette that brought VDAs under PMLA — what the market has not absorbed.
- [The Indian crypto winter was actually a regulatory winter](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/indian-crypto-winter-was-regulatory-winter.md): Why the 2022-2024 Indian curve does not match the global one, and what the survivors look like.
- [Web3 in India after the 1% TDS — what survived](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/web3-in-india-after-1-percent-tds-what-survived.md): The category-by-category survivor census of post-TDS Indian Web3.
- [How Indian retail traders behave differently from US retail](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/indian-retail-vs-us-retail-trader-behaviour.md): Six measurable differences and what they mean for product decisions.
- [INR stablecoins — when, how, who, and what could block them](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/inr-stablecoins-when-how-who-block.md): The mechanism, the candidate issuers, and the three blockers.

### Trading psychology

- [The behaviour gap — measure it in your own trade journal](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/the-behaviour-gap-in-your-trade-journal.md): How to compute your personal gap and what it reveals.
- [Why leverage feels different at 3 AM](https://intrepidkarthi.com/writing/why-leverage-feels-different-at-3am.md): The physiological, structural, and behavioural cases for hard-coded position limits.
